args.text: Start a note to June about the PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb, and Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'. Post the bullets here.

args.subject: Pellow Home Living: PHL label confusion
args.body:
Hi June,

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. The account code is PHL.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so filtering on PHL returns both accounts. Use the full account name when filing or searching.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs its label changed to Pellow Home Living.

Sofia

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A quick cleanup note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. The account code is PHL.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so filtering on PHL returns both accounts.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs its label changed to Pellow Home Living.

Please use the full account name when filing or searching, not PHL.

Thanks,
Bettina
